admission_gates: projected gain material enough to justify complexity
allowed_causal_signals: TimingData.Stopped latest value <= T and transition times <= T
TimingData.PitOut latest value <= T (as state, never future)
TimingData.Retired latest value <= T (J contract, exclusion only)
D9 canonical state <= T (lap/pos/tyre/pit count/track status)
elapsed time since stop start (T minus stop-start time)

allowed_inputs: tyre change context if known at T
candidate_duration_model.family: simple empirical/parametric conditional distribution; no driver identity; no future outcome

coverage_rules.checkpoint_pit_fully_addressable: every unresolved stale offender is J_RETIRED or PIT_LIFECYCLE_CANDIDATE (causal classification only, no future outcome)

episode_exclusion_rules: CLEAN/INITIAL_UNKNOWN/LATE_SESSION episodes are context only, never training for pit duration
RED/neutralised-affected pit episodes excluded from duration modelling
episode_inclusion_rules: audit all 214 PIT_CONTEXT episodes with causal/future table separation
forbidden_future_signals: actual historical remaining service time at inference

inherited_target_population.note: frozen V3.2L identities; M projects only, recounts only if admitted

parity_rules.new_rng_domain: e.g. mc2-initial-pit-delay; existing MC2-E streams untouched; old-state sims consume zero new draws
parity_rules.old_eligible: all 3678 existing eligible checkpoints remain eligible

pit_context_under_investigation.definition: L episode with latest causally observed TimingData InPit value True at stop start (Stopped False->True or first-True transition time). Nothing more is assumed.

pit_return_analysis.gate: if routine service cannot be separated causally from garage/terminal states: REJECT
pit_return_analysis.return_def_mechanism: which event corresponds to MC2 resumption decided in duration-target analysis (PitOut vs D9 crossing), not by lowest error
pit_return_analysis.return_def_primary: competitive D9 lap crossing after stop start (same L definition)
pit_return_analysis.target: P(return | candidate causal pit state) with uncertainty/sample count

remaining_duration_target.conditioning: P(additional pit delay | elapsed pit duration, causal context); sample must never imply completion before T
remaining_duration_target.definition: time from checkpoint T until driver resumes exact competitive process required by MC2
remaining_duration_target.mc2_resumption_event: to be determined (PitOut vs D9 crossing); chosen by mechanism semantics

rng_policy: stdlib/deterministic; dedicated domain reserved only if admitted; no perturbation of frozen streams

runtime_mechanism_gate.precedence: J Retired=True retains absolute precedence; M never reactivates J-retired driver
runtime_mechanism_gate.rule: FUNDAMENTAL_KERNEL_REWRITE -> do not implement in M (defer/reject)

stopping_rule: routine pit not causally separable from garage/terminal -> REJECT
gain immaterial vs complexity -> REJECT as tradeoff
never weaken a gate to increase coverage

always: API tests only if API changed
testing_policy.full_tier1_only_if: admitted + shared runtime/MC2 modified, or targeted testing shows cross-cutting regression
